{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Fire| trainername=Paul| pokemonname=Magmortar| jtrainername=シンジ| jpokemonname=ブーバーン | tmtrainername=Shinji| tmpokemonname=Booburn| image=[[File:Paul Magmortar.png|250px]]| caption=Paul's Magmortar | ability={{a|Flame Body}} | evolution=1| epnum=DP066| numeps1=between 62 and 64| firststagename=Magmar| numeps2=an unknown number of| secondstagename=Magmortar| epname=Lost Leader Strategy!| location=[[Sinnoh]]| firstevoep=DP131| firstevonametiming=Prior to| firstevoname=Pedal to the Mettle!| prevonum=126| evo1num=467| current=In storage| java1=[[Yūji Ueda]]| java2=[[Yūji Ueda]]| enva1=[[Tom Wayland]]| enva2=[[Tom Wayland]]| }} '''Paul's Magmortar''' (Japanese: '''シンジのブーバーン''' ''Shinji's Booburn'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Paul]]. ==History== [[File:Paul and Magmortar.png|thumb|250px|left|Magmortar and Paul]] Magmortar debuted in ''[[DP066|Lost Leader Strategy!]]'' as a {{p|Magmar}} where it appeared in a flashback. [[Reggie]] explained to {{Ash}} that it easily defeated [[Maylene]]'s {{type|Steel}} {{TP|Maylene|Lucario}} with its {{m|Fire Spin}} and {{m|Fire Punch}} attacks, thus earning him the {{badge|Cobble}}. It made its physical debut in ''[[DP100|Aiding the Enemy!]]'', resting with Paul's other Pokémon. In ''[[DP128|A Pyramiding Rage!]]'', Magmar was the first Pokémon chosen by Paul during his match against {{an|Brandon|Pyramid King Brandon}}. He quickly [[recall]]ed it after he saw Brandon chose {{DL|Brandon's legendary giants|Regirock}} to battle it. He sent it out again to battle {{DL|Brandon's legendary giants|Registeel}}. Registeel was able to shrug off Flamethrower with little difficulty and struck with {{m|Iron Head}}, not causing much damage but making Magmar [[flinch]] and unable to use Will-O-Wisp. Paul recalled Magmar, but after all of Paul's other Pokémon were defeated, Paul sent out Magmar to once again battle Regirock, who easily tanked a Flamethrower attack and took Magmar out with {{m|Shock Wave}}. [[File:Paul Magmortar Flame Body effect.png|thumb|250px|left|{{a|Flame Body}} activated]] In ''[[DP131|Pedal to the Mettle!]]'', Magmar was revealed to have evolved into Magmortar when Paul chose it as his fifth Pokémon to battle [[Ash's Pikachu]]. They began the battle in ''[[DP132|Evolving Strategies!]]'', where Pikachu got badly {{status|burn}}ed because of Magmortar's {{a|Flame Body}}. Magmortar's powerful Flamethrower blocked Pikachu's {{m|Thunderbolt}}, and then cleverly used {{m|Rock Tomb}} to damage Pikachu during his {{m|Volt Tackle}}. Magmortar used {{m|Smog}} in an attempt to choke Pikachu but this was blocked by [[Counter Shield]]. However, Pikachu's attempt to follow up with {{m|Iron Tail}} did not cause nearly enough damage to Magmortar, and Ash recalled him for {{AP|Buizel}}. Despite the type disadvantage, Magmortar was able to hold its own, managing to carry on after a direct hit from {{m|Aqua Jet}}. It used a wall of Rock Tombs to block {{m|Water Pulse}}, which turned out to be a distraction; while Buizel blasted through easily, Magmortar had vanished. It was revealed to have jumped into the air, landing a hit with Smog and poisoning Buizel. While Buizel choked, Paul recalled Magmortar. It wasn't used for the rest of the battle, but the burn it inflicted on Pikachu continued to affect him during a later battle against {{TP|Paul|Ursaring}}. In ''[[DP184|Casting a Paul on Barry!]]'', Magmortar was used in the battle against {{an|Barry}}'s {{p|Skarmory}} and it won with a single {{m|Flamethrower}}. Then, Magmortar fought against [[Barry's Empoleon]], where it was shown to be strong enough to withstand Empoleon's {{m|Hydro Cannon}}. It was recalled by Paul, much to Barry's disappointment. ==Personality and characteristics== Magmortar is considered to be one of Paul's trusted Pokémon in terms of strategies for his battles. Beginning in ''[[DP132|Evolving Strategies!]]'', it had the ability to take in any attacks that was delivered including the ones that would have been super effective against Magmortar. ==Appearance== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{fire color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{fire color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{fire color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Magmar|000}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Paul Magmar.png|250px]] |} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|fire||Paul Magmortar {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Flamethrower|1=Rock Tomb|2=Smog}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Flamethrower|1=Rock Tomb|2=Smog}}|image2=Paul Magmar {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Fire Spin|1=Fire Punch|2=Flamethrower}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Fire Spin|1=Fire Punch|2=Flamethrower}}
as a Magmar}} {{anmov|fire|Fire Spin|DP066|Lost Leader Strategy!}} {{anmov|fire|Fire Punch|DP066|Lost Leader Strategy!}} {{anmov|fire|Flamethrower|DP128|A Pyramiding Rage!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|fire|Will-O-Wisp|DP128|A Pyramiding Rage!{{tt|*|Paul called for the attack, but Magmar couldn't use it because it flinched.}}}} {{anmov|rock|Rock Tomb|DP132|Evolving Strategies!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|poison|Smog|DP132|Evolving Strategies!|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|fire}} ==Trivia== * Magmortar is the only Pokémon Paul has used against Ash that has never knocked out or been knocked out by any of Ash's Pokémon. ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo1|Magmar|Magmortar}} {{-}} {{Paul's Pokémon|fire}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Paul's Pokémon]] [[de:Pauls Magbrant]] [[es:Magmortar de Paul/Polo]] [[fr:Maganon de Paul]] [[it:Magmortar di Paul]] [[ja:シンジのブーバーン]] [[zh:真司的鸭嘴炎兽]]
